name: timeline
title: Timeline
description: Spans over time in lanes: a workflow's history as bars (a workflow, its activities, timers, child workflows, signals) on a zoomable time axis, with running items that grow to now.
usage: Use it to show when things happened and how they overlapped, for a history, a trace or a job run: one lane per thing, one bar per span, an instant when start equals end. Pass lanes and items with times in milliseconds on one clock and `now` for the running ones; the app decides which lane an event belongs to. Pair it with a table of the same events for exact values: the Timeline is for shape, not for reading numbers. It is plain DOM (no charting library), windows its lanes, and zooms with + and - (Ctrl+wheel), pans with the arrows (Shift+wheel) and fits with Home.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the timeline for assistive technology, for example "History timeline of order-1".

props.name: lanes
props.description: The rows, top to bottom. Thousands are fine: only the lanes in view are drawn.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; laneId: string; start: number; end: number | null; status: TimelineStatus; label: string }[]
props.description: The spans, times in ms on any one clock. `end: null` is running and grows to `now`; `start === end` is an instant.

props.name: now
props.description: The current time on the items' clock: running items end here and a marker shows it.

props.name: selectedId
props.description: The selected item; its bar is ringed and aria-pressed.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called when a bar is pressed (click, Enter or Space).

props.name: origin
props.description: Where the axis starts counting; the earliest start by default. Ticks read as offsets from it.

props.name: describeItem
props.description: How a bar is described to a screen reader; "label, status, duration" by default.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Shown when there are no lanes.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own. Give it a height: the lanes scroll inside.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The focusable group; data-slot="timeline". Holds the keyboard controls.

slots.name: axis
slots.description: The time axis with its round ticks; data-slot="timeline-axis".

slots.name: lanes
slots.description: The scrolling, windowed area of lanes; data-slot="timeline-lanes".

slots.name: lane
slots.description: One row with its label and track; data-slot="timeline-lane".

slots.name: item
slots.description: One bar; data-slot="timeline-item", data-status, data-selected and data-running name its state.

states.name: selected
states.description: The chosen bar is ringed in color.ring.

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer over a bar: it dims slightly.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus on the timeline or a bar: Fluent's double ring (focusRing from @/lib/control).

accessibility: The timeline is a focusable role=group named by aria-label; its keys (+, -, arrows, Home) are announced by a visually hidden hint it is described by.
Each bar is a native button whose label is "label, status, duration" (or describeItem), with aria-pressed when a selection is controlled.
Status is never colour alone: the label names it. The axis is hidden from assistive technology; the bars carry the times.
Focus shows the double ring: ring.width in color.ring around ring.inner-width in color.ring-inner (3:1 on every surface).
